## Intake review

- **Still live:** filed today (2026-10-31) by Drew under the id program directive; issue search finds no duplicate and no PR touches the text-only websocket path — the two existing `world_ws` e2e tests both use the Screen roc-counter, as the issue states.
- **Notes:** the body already carried a `## Acceptance` section; a standard `## Acceptance criteria` checklist has been appended (original body preserved verbatim above it) so label/tooling greps find it. Scope is cleanly bounded: legacy UTF-8 text path only — the line/teletype presentation tiers are #786's design space and are explicitly out of scope here.
- **Risks:** fuel baselines for a new example kind must be measured, not copied from the Screen counter; test (b)'s value is the capability-ceiling proof, so the ceiling must genuinely exclude Screen rather than merely not import it.
- **Suggested approach:** mirror the two existing `world_ws` tests' harness; add the example + sandbox fuel rows first, then the upload and compile-from-source cases.
- **Labels:** kind/test, source/human, status/needs-triage, priority/normal, effort/m, app/id.

## Triage verdict — task 8196; current-main check

**#3181 remains live; keep it open. Scope is coherent and no duplicate/superseding implementation was found.**

Verified on main `f34b6fd4e980b252419d01af6fbbd4dff00e6ef6`:

- There is no dedicated minimal Screen-free text example. `roc-chat` and `lounge` return plain text but still import capability modules; `roc-counter` imports `pf.Screen` and `pf.RocText`.
- The existing WebSocket upload/run test (`pkgs/id/src/web/world_ws.rs:1434-1511`) and compile-from-source test (`:1513-1600`) both exercise `roc-counter`; the latter explicitly grants Screen and RocText. Add cases rather than replacing these Screen-path tests.
- Register the new example in `pkgs/id/src/sandbox.rs` `examples()` and `FUEL_BUDGETS` (around lines 2410-2452 and 2521-2588); the existing fuel coverage test is `checked_in_examples_stay_within_fuel_budgets` (:2672-2707).
- Scope is distinct from #786, which covers future presentation tiers and remains out of this issue. The existing upload/source tests use a real WebSocket connection in the Rust harness (`tokio-tungstenite`), not a browser engine; if “browser-websocket” requires Playwright, clarify that before implementation.
- The current source-compile test can skip when Roc or the built platform is unavailable. Ensure the new test actually runs in the required Nix check rather than passing by skip.

**Next:** add one minimal no-Screen example with measured fuel rows, then add the upload and compile-from-source WebSocket cases with Screen excluded; preserve existing Screen coverage and ensure CI executes the compile case. No code or tests were run in this triage.
